A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Imperial Advisor''' with a purple [[Clothing/Legends|robe]] was one of six who accompanied [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Starships" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] with pale skin served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was one of a small group of Imperial dignitaries who had the privilege of conferring privately with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Insider 96" />

He was also one of a mere few hundred, out of several thousand [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]] who ran the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]], who demonstrated genuine loyalty to the Emperor and his New Order. Those individuals were appointed to the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]], also known as the Emperor's Inner Circle, which operated on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Starships" /> They managed the Empire and carried out the Emperor's will. Palpatine encouraged competition between his Advisors by tasking them with overseeing both their home [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and the systems of rival Advisors as well.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> By doing so, Palpatine kept them loyal to him while discouraging internal cooperation and alliances between them. To promote further suspicion, he doted on only a select few at any given [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref>

High-ranking advisors often wore lavish [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] indicative of their status,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and the Human male wore a headdress and a purple robe.<ref name="Starships" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the purple-robed Advisor was one of six<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Inner Circle members<ref name="Insider 96" /> who accompanied Palpatine to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. After arriving aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]] in the Emperor's [[Emperor's personal shuttle/Legends|private shuttle]], the group, flanked by Palpatine's [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]], emerged into a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and were greeted by a welcoming assembly of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The Emperor's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], personally greeted Palpatine, and as the two walked from the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the six advisors silently followed in their wake. A short time later, the [[Death Star/Legends|station]] was destroyed during an [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|starfleet]],<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> and all six Advisors were [[Death/Legends|killed]],<ref name="Kren Blista-Vanee Galactic File Card" /> alongside both Vader and the Emperor.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Blista-Vanee is one of six advisors who accompanies Emperor Palpatine to the second Death Star in 4 ABY; all are killed when the station is destroyed.|Kren Blista-Vanee's character card in the ''2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2'' series|<ref name="Kren Blista-Vanee Galactic File Card" />}}
[[File:Sixthadvisorcontinuitypolaroid.jpg|thumb|left|275px|A continuity polaroid of the sixth advisor]]
In [[2013]], the ''[[2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2]]'' trading card set confirmed a longstanding fan suspicion that there were six, and not five, Imperial Advisors who followed Emperor Palpatine onto the second Death Star in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Kren Blista-Vanee Galactic File Card" /> A [[:File:ImperialAdvisors.png|promotional photo]] of the other five advisors had been used in several official ''[[Star Wars]]'' sources,<ref name="Insider 96" /><ref name="The Gentlemen with the Emperor">{{SWArchive|url=community/askjc/jocasta/askjc20030602.html|text=Ask the Lucasfilm Jedi Council: Who are the gentlemen with the Emperor?}}</ref> but despite his omission from it, the sixth advisor and the unique black shawl worn over his shoulders is in fact clearly visible on the far left of [[:File:Welcomeaboard.jpg|another common image]], this one a shot of the group departing the Emperor's shuttle.<ref name="Starships" /> A continuity polaroid from the film of the sixth advisor, as well as polaroids of fellow advisors [[Sim Aloo/Legends|Sim Aloo]], a [[Unidentified Imperial Advisor (tall hat)|tall-hatted fellow]], and a [[Unidentified Imperial Advisor (black robe)|black-robed one]], can be found at the website [http://www.starwarsarchives.com starwarsarchives.com].<ref name="Continuity Polaroids">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsarchives.com/dt_gallery/1983-continuity-polaroids|text=Return of the Jedi continuity polaroids|work=Star Wars Archives|archivedate=20180314171407}}</ref>

All of the advisors' outfits were inspired by [[Wikipedia:Catholic Church|Catholic]] [[Wikipedia:Bishop|bishops]], whom the film's assistant art director, [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], looked to when designing the robes and elaborate headgear of all of the Advisors.<ref name="Annotated Screenplays">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> Several advisors appear in concept art of the arrival scene by artist [[Ralph McQuarrie]].<ref name="Art of Ralph McQuarrie">''[[The Art of Ralph McQuarrie]]''</ref>

The arrival scene was also described in [[James Kahn]]'s [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of ''Return of the Jedi'', in which the group is called "the Emperor's courtiers."<ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> The sixth advisor has never been individually mentioned in a source, but information about his role on the Ruling Council and the Inner Circle has been revealed by sources that give blanket information for all six of the movie's advisors.<ref name="Starships" /><ref name="Insider 96" /><ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />
